import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MAXN = 1000000007;
    static final int SIZE = 1000010;
    
    static long ways;
    static int P, K;
    static int[] Parent = new int[SIZE];
    static int[] Rank = new int[SIZE];
    static Set<Integer> groups = new HashSet<>();
    
    static int find_parent(int nd) {
        if (Parent[nd] != nd) {
            Parent[nd] = find_parent(Parent[nd]);
        }
        return Parent[nd];
    }
    
    static void Union(int nd1, int nd2) {
        if (Rank[nd1] >= Rank[nd2]) {
            Parent[nd2] = nd1;
            ++Rank[nd1];
        } else {
            Parent[nd1] = nd2;
            ++Rank[nd2];
        }
    }
    
    static long fast_exp_pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % mod;
            }
            
            exp >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        
        return res;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        P = scanner.nextInt();
        K = scanner.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            Parent[i] = i;
            Rank[i] = 1;
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            int value = (int) (((long) K * (long) i) % P);
            int Pa = find_parent(i);
            int Pb = find_parent(value);
            
            if (Pa != Pb) {
                Union(Pa, Pb);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            groups.add(find_parent(i));
        }
        
        if (K == 0) {
            ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P - 1, MAXN);
        } else if (K == 1) {
            ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P, MAXN);
        } else {
            ways = fast_exp_pow(P, groups.size(), MAXN);
        }
        
        System.out.println(ways);
    }
}
